title: Seam configuration decomposition
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with $m$ Boolean work tapes and state set $\Lambda$, and let $k_D$ be a natural number. The configuration obtained by mapping its state into the program-state component and adjoining $k_D$ blank work tapes with heads at position $0$ is equal to the configuration assembled from its original state, input-head position, work tapes, work-head positions, and output together with those same $k_D$ blank tapes and zero-position heads.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ with $m$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, state set $\Lambda$, and fixed input
